text:
devon: Heads up — after the 22:10 deploy we're seeing NVMe IOPS sampling variance across a subset of gnodes in us-west1. GPU attach times spiked, some attaches delayed by ~30-90s. iostat shows bursts then drop to 0.
infra-bot: deploy:wave: Redeploy completed by @devon at 22:10 — services: ephemeral-janitor, io-sampler
mia: which change touched the sampler? any config tweaks? :thinking_face:
devon: changed io-sampler sampling_window from 1000ms -> 250ms to catch short-lived bursts (PR #4321). Also enabled per-device sampling in the janitor loop.
arya: ah. shorter window will make the signal noisier, especially when cleaner/evictor runs in waves. we saw similar oscillation in eu w/ scrub overlap.
sam: can you paste a small snippet of the iostat pattern? curious about duty cycle
devon: sure — grabbed a host from the impacted pool:
```
Device:         tps   Blk_read/s  Blk_wrtn/s
nvme0n1        420     12000       0
nvme0n1        180      5000       0
nvme0n1          8         40      0
nvme0n1        380     11000       0
```
devon: pattern is high bursts then near-zero for 5-10s; sampler treats zeros as low health and triggers extra cleanup/faster evacuations, which knocks GPUs off the attach path.
mia: can we short-circuit sampler to ignore sub-1s zeros? maybe apply a 2-sample moving average or require two consecutive low-samples before marking unhealthy.
lee: as a short mitigation we can bump attach timeout on the provisioner from 60s -> 180s and add temporary routing to us-east pool for preemptible-heavy jobs.
arya: longer term we should revert sampling_window to 1000ms and add a weighted moving average (WMA) with alpha=0.3 so bursts are smoothed but still visible.
sam: alternative is to make the janitor less aggressive on devices flagged by the sampler — add hysteresis state: "suspect" -> wait 10s -> "degraded".
devon: agree with revert+WMA. will open rollback PR and add WMA implementation. also will add a flag to disable per-device janitor-triggering until we validate.
infra-bot: incident-note: gpu-provisioning-delay detected for tag=gnode-uswest1-ephemeral; alert page created — https://pager.example/INC-2026
mia: quick checklist for mitigation: 1) revert sampler window in canary, 2) increase attach timeout, 3) disable per-device janitor triggers, 4) run manual drain/rebalance on most noisy hosts
arya: I can run the drain on the two hottest hosts and watch attach latency during canary.
devon: thanks. I'll land PR for revert and WMA, target canary in 10m. calling @sam to add hysteresis for janitor as follow-up.
sam: on it — will queue a small change for janitor state machine, won't block the canary rollback.
lee: I'll prepare routing change in infra to spill to us-east for heavy jobs, ready to flip if rollback doesn't land in 20m.
devon: plan: roll back sampler window in canary now, monitor attach latency and iostat for 30m; if stable, roll to main. owner: devon. backups: arya (drains), lee (routing), sam (janitor hysteresis).
mia: thanks team — please post results in this thread. :checkered_flag:
devon: canary rollback applied at 22:24 — monitoring now. initial attach latencies dropping back toward baseline (10-20s). will update at +15m and +30m.
